claims.speaker: Mike Sena
claims.sentence: Consolidated total revenue for the third quarter of 2026 was $495.5 million, an increase of 42.8% compared to $347.1 million in the prior year period.

claims.speaker: Mike Sena
claims.sentence: Net income attributable to common stockholders and participating preferred stockholders for the third quarter of 2026 was $15.8 million, or $1.10 per fully diluted share, compared to a net loss of $9.4 million, or $0.71 per fully diluted share in the prior year period.

claims.speaker: Mike Sena
claims.sentence: At infrastructure, revenue increased 45% to $490.6 million from $338.4 million in the prior year quarter.

claims.speaker: Mike Sena
claims.sentence: At Life Sciences, revenue decreased 61.3% to $1.2 million from $3.1 million in the prior year quarter.
